duration_basis: 10m at target threshold 0.10m/s; planning point, not new maximum duration

efficiency_comparison.status: Manufacturer efficiency statement without operating-condition bound; not guaranteed minimum

definitions.E_usable_Wh: Energy deliverable before qualified per-cell cutoff, including load, temperature and pack age
definitions.eta: Guaranteed energy-weighted conversion efficiency for the actual servo branch profile, including distribution loss
definitions.P_aux_battery_W: Average battery-side Tab5 and control power over the 100-second planning interval
definitions.E_other_Wh: Additional startup/shutdown energy outside that interval and explicitly chosen reserve, without double-counting

limitations: Conditional ideal bridge load envelope, not qualified hardware DC maximum
Nominal battery Wh is not usable energy
No claim of 20 trials on one charge
Current pulses, thermal limits, wiring and protection remain separate constraints
